issue.title: [Epic] Multi-user projects
issue.body:
### Summary

Epic tracking multi-user project scoping and **My Work** filtering on the **Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only) baseline**. Most of this is **already built** on main (`user_projects` table, `chapter_assignments.peer_checker_id`, `MyWorkTab` + `useMyWorkChapters` + `mergeUserChapterAssignments` with tests). The work is **hardening**: restore integrity constraints dropped from `chapter_assignments`/`user_projects`, verify filtering correctness, and add active-user attribution for recordings. [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) is referenced only for anti-patterns.

**Verify pass (2026-07):** #104 verified complete and closed. #103 and #105 remain open.

Known baseline gaps to fix:
- `chapter_assignments.assigned_user_id` lost its `REFERENCES users(id)`; `status` lost its default; `idx_ca_assigned_user` is missing (#103).
- `user_projects.user_id` has no FK (#103).
- Recordings join uses `bible_text_id` on main (was broken via `chapter_assignment_id`; fixed before #104 verification).

### Sub-issues
- [x] #103
- [x] #104
- [x] #105

### Dependency ordering
1. **#110 (F2 migrations)** first.
2. **#103 (D1)** owns the FK/index/default migration for `chapter_assignments` + `user_projects` (referenced by #99).
3. **#104 (D2)** — **done** — My Work filtering verified.
4. **#105 (D3)** adds recordings user-attribution (bundled into the #103/#99 migration set).

### Note
Account switcher, add-account, and offline account switching are **already tracked** — do not duplicate:
- #84 Build Account Switcher Panel
- #85 Add Initials Indicator to Drafting Page Header
- #86 Implement Add Account Flow with Three-Account Cap
- #87 Implement Account Switching with Offline and Error Handling

### Links
- Anti-pattern reference only (not merging): [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82)
- Related: #31 (My Work tab)

comments.body:
